The runtime is the external clearvoice 0.1.2 package (adapter identity ClearerVoice-Studio-clearvoice-0.1.2) whose research requirements lock is pinned by digest but which has no wheel or sdist digest, no installed environment and no execution evidence here; adapters/clearvoice/run.py is not executed and no vendor runtime is invoked.

Apache-2.0 is recorded for the code and the Apache-2.0 model card at https://huggingface.co/alibabasglab/MossFormerGAN_SE_16K, but the model card states open and private training data with exact corpus exposure undisclosed; artifact-specific weight rights, training-data provenance, redistribution and product-use clearance, and legal review are not established. No checkpoint, pointer, runtime or upstream source may be vendored, packaged, downloaded or redistributed by this package.

No rights-cleared held-out real cohort, independent clean-reference scorer, permitted listening result, target-runtime timing measurement or approved exact MossFormerGAN reference output vector exists; every release gate remains blocked.
